rules.heading: Transcript reading facts (genuine owner message)
rules.quote: **Genuine owner message**: a `user` entry with no `tool_result` block, not `isMeta`, `origin.kind` "human".
rules.says: A genuine owner message in the transcript is a user entry that has no tool_result block, is not isMeta, and has origin.kind "human"; anything else is not to be counted as an owner message.

rules.heading: Transcript reading facts (genuine owner message)
rules.quote: The 160 "Stop hook feedback" entries are all `isMeta`.
rules.says: The 160 "Stop hook feedback" user entries in the transcript are all isMeta, so they are not genuine owner messages.

rules.heading: What the research workflow measured (for building the gates)
rules.quote: **ExitPlanMode results**: approved content starts "User has approved your plan";
rules.says: An ExitPlanMode result whose content starts "User has approved your plan" is an approval of the plan.

rules.heading: What the research workflow measured (for building the gates)
rules.quote: the common rejection is `is_error: true` with `toolDenialKind: "permission-rule"` and the owner's text as the whole content; a rarer one starts "The user doesn't want to proceed with this tool use";
rules.says: An ExitPlanMode rejection is either an is_error result with toolDenialKind "permission-rule" whose whole content is the owner's text (the common form), or a result starting "The user doesn't want to proceed with this tool use" (the rarer form).

rules.heading: What the research workflow measured (for building the gates)
rules.says: An ExitPlanMode result with toolDenialKind "cancelled" is not to be counted as a rejection.

rules.heading: What the research workflow measured (for building the gates)
rules.says: An EnterPlanMode result starts with "Entered plan mode", which is how entry to plan mode is recognised in a transcript.

rules.heading: What the research workflow measured (for building the gates)
rules.quote: The `type: "mode"` entries do NOT record plan mode; `permissionMode` on user entries does.
rules.says: Plan mode must be read from the permissionMode field on user entries in the transcript, never from type "mode" entries, which do not record it.

rules.heading: What the research workflow measured (for building the gates)
rules.quote: **Mid-turn text** is recorded for some messages only: of 7,400 messages that follow a tool result and call a tool, 2,253 carry text. A gate cannot rely on reading chat text;
rules.says: Mid-turn chat text is recorded for only some messages (2,253 of 7,400 tool-calling messages that follow a tool result), so a gate must not rely on reading chat text from the transcript.
rules.enforcer: report-clock (uses its own stamp instead of chat text)

rules.heading: What the research workflow measured (for building the gates)
rules.quote: report-clock uses its own stamp for that reason.
rules.says: report-clock must use its own stamp rather than the transcript's chat text to know about reports.

rules.heading: What the research workflow measured (for building the gates)
rules.quote: **The transcript is over 512 MB.** Never read it whole; stream or read a tail.
rules.says: The session transcript is over 512 MB, so a session or gate must never read it whole and must stream it or read only a tail.
